latest_release.body:
# Repository History Rewrite - DMCA Compliance

## Important Changes
This release represents a force-pushed version of the repository after removing content subject to a DMCA takedown notice.

## What Changed
- 8 workflow files have been permanently removed from all git history
- Repository history has been rewritten
- All existing forks and clones are now out of sync

## Required Actions for Users

### For Forks
Please delete and re-fork the repository, or force-sync with upstream.

### For Local Clones
Please re-clone the repository or force-reset to origin/main.

## Removed Files
- workflows/1980_Splitout_Code_Automation_Webhook.json
- workflows/1323_Splitout_Code_Automation_Webhook.json
- workflows/1977_Wait_Splitout_Automation_Webhook.json
- workflows/1994_Code_Manual_Automation_Webhook.json
- workflows/1666_Code_Manual_Automation_Webhook.json
- workflows/1352_Splitout_Filter_Automate_Triggered.json
- workflows/1840_Splitout_Filter_Automate_Triggered.json
- workflows/1591_Splitout_Code_Automate_Webhook.json

## Note
This was a required legal compliance action to prevent the repository from being disabled.
